You are rebuilding every page of the **Casino Scout** template, a casinos site (angle: overall). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in English); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

---

# Rebuild brief: Casino Scout

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: rank and review licensed casinos with a comparison table.
- Ranking order always follows the computed scores; a paid (featured) brand appears only in a labelled slot and keeps its real rank.
- Every listed brand must be licensed in the market; the build refuses unlicensed ones.
- Each review page explains how the score was computed and links the method page.
- Comparison values come from brand facts with a checked date; never type them by hand.

## Market guidance

### Market context

- Market: Demoland (demo only) (`xx`), languages en, ru, pt, currency EUR
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code, odds_boost, cashback, loyalty, tournaments
- Payment methods: visa-debit, mastercard-debit, apple-pay, bank
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android play
- Notes: Every promotion type is allowed here so the full promo-page design can be reviewed. Mirror the first real market that uses the promo type.

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: 18+ only. Offers are subject to terms.
- Self-exclusion: Self-exclusion and deposit-limit tools are available in every account.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- DEMO-ONLY market: never ship it to a real site; the build refuses it unless the config has "demo": true.
- Every promotion type is allowed so promo designs can be reviewed; label offers and keep their terms visible.
- Use euros and the demo payment methods only.

## Site context

- Site: Casino Scout (https://casinoscout.example)
- Site type: casinos, angle overall; language `en`, text direction `ltr`
- Pages (10):
  - `index.html` — Best online casinos in Demoland: 2026 ranking
  - `reviews-marlowe.html` — Marlowe Club review: scores, bonus terms and payouts
  - `reviews-nyxa.html` — Nyxa review: scores, bonus terms and payouts
  - `reviews-verazul.html` — Verazul review: scores, bonus terms and payouts
  - `reviews-lunaro.html` — Lunaro review: scores, bonus terms and payouts
  - `reviews-cobaltio.html` — Cobaltio review: scores, bonus terms and payouts
  - `compare.html` — Compare online casinos in Demoland
  - `fast-withdrawals.html` — Fastest-paying casinos in Demoland
  - `live-casino.html` — Best live casinos in Demoland
  - `how-we-rate.html` — How we score casinos

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): Onest.

Use these CSS custom properties (they are the whole palette, type scale and radius set):

```css
:root {
  --c-bg: #FFF7E6;
  --c-surface: #FFFFFF;
  --c-surface-2: #FFEFCC;
  --c-text: #1F1A0E;
  --c-muted: #6B5E3E;
  --c-border: #F0DFB5;

  --f-body: "Onest",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;

```

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Affiliate disclosure: Fixed wording per locale; cannot be removed on review sites.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Brand ranking: Order always follows the computed scores.
- Brand ranking: A featured (paid) brand is shown only in a labelled slot and keeps its real rank.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Brand header: Score is computed; verdict comes from brands/ratings/<market>.json.
- Score box: Every score shows its reason. Criteria a market does not score (e.g. bonuses in BR) are hidden, with a note.
- Pros and cons: Cons are mandatory and never hidden.
- Key facts: Facts come from brands/facts/<market>.json with a checked date; studios from the brand catalog.
- Comparison table: Columns follow the overall ranking.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Rating criteria: Weights shown are the weights used; nothing is typed in content.

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Best online casinos in Demoland: 2026 ranking
- Meta description: Five licensed casinos tested for payouts, games, live tables, app, support and bonus terms. Every score has a written reason. 18+.
- The only H1: Best online casinos, every score explained
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `index.html`, `compare.html`, `fast-withdrawals.html`, `live-casino.html`, `how-we-rate.html`, `reviews-marlowe.html`, `reviews-nyxa.html`, `reviews-verazul.html`, `reviews-lunaro.html`, `reviews-cobaltio.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `strip`, role `compliance`
   Purpose: Market-driven responsible gambling notice: age, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion, helpline.
   - `show_verify`: false
2. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `line`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
3. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
4. **Brand ranking** — block `sx/toplist`, variant `podium`, role `content`
   Purpose: Ranked brands with score, one reason, the key fact for the page and a CTA per brand. Order = scores; one labelled featured slot at most.
   - `heading`: "h1"
   - `title`: "Best online casinos, every score explained"
   - `intro`: "We opened real accounts at five licensed casinos and scored seven things that matter. The list follows the overall score; tap a casino for the reasons."
   - `limit`: "0"
   - `show_featured`: true
   - `exclude_current`: false
5. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Links to the site's other pages with a one-line blurb: service pages on home, related pages elsewhere.
6. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Are these casinos licensed?","a":"Yes. Every casino listed shows a Demoland Gaming Authority licence."},{"q":"How do you test withdrawals?","a":"We deposit, play and request at least five withdrawals per casino on different days, then record the time until the money arrives."},{"q":"Do casinos pay to be listed?","a":"We earn commission when you sign up through our links. It never changes a score or a position, and this page has no paid slot."},{"q":"How are bonuses scored?","a":"On wagering, time limits and how clearly the terms are written. The size of the offer does not count."},{"q":"Can I set deposit limits?","a":"Yes. Every casino here offers deposit and session limits in the account area, plus self-exclusion."}]`
7. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `split`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Pick the one that fits you"
   - `text`: "All five casinos are licensed. Set a limit before you play. 18+."
   - `show_code`: false
8. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `columns`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
9. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
10. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `bar`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.
